article.story: CEDAR FALLS, Iowa -- — Greyson Uelmen had 27 points in Northern Iowa’s 89-76 victory over Green Bay on Tuesday. Uelmen shot 8 of 14 from the field, including 3 for 7 from 3-point range, and went 8 for 10 from the line for the Panthers (2-1). Carson Vis scored 17 points and added five assists and four steals. Levi Valdo went 7 of 8 from the field to finish with 15 points. Orlando Lovejoy led the way for the Phoenix (2-2) with 18 points, four assists and three steals. Ne’quan Brown added 17 points and 10 rebounds for Green Bay. Marcus Hall had 15 points. Up next Both teams play Friday. Northern Iowa visits Michigan State and Green Bay hosts Viterbo. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
